answers.core: Stylized rendering (NPR) is becoming more commonplace, and as it does, creators want more control over the render pipeline. Having the ability to do this directly would be great. I am hopeful that this is possible with Godot 4.0 and Vulkan.
answers.workaround: This method is appearing in more places, as clean linework is a necessity for stylized characters. For Godot, the [Godot Shader Secrets](https://github.com/GDQuest/godot-shaders) project from GDQuest does include an interesting method for this (Pixel Perfect Outline). It's probably the best method available right now in Godot. I still would like to play around with full-screen normal + depth though.

title: Access to full screen normal texture in shader
